{"code": "import collections
import urllib.request

def get_neighbors(word, word_list):
    neighbors = []
    for i in range(len(word)):
        for char in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ':
            neighbor = word[:i] + char + word[i+1:]
            if neighbor != word and neighbor in word_list:
                neighbors.append(neighbor)
    return neighbors

def bfs(start, target, word_list):
    queue = collections.deque([[start]])
    visited = {start}
    while queue:
        path = queue.popleft()
        current_word = path[-1]
        if current_word == target:
            return path
        for neighbor in get_neighbors(current_word, word_list):
            if neighbor not in visited:
                visited.add(neighbor)
                queue.append(path + [neighbor])
    return None

# Using a different word list (standard English words)
url = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/first20hours/google-10000-english/master/google-10000-english-no-swears.txt'
response = urllib.request.urlopen(url)
words = set(word.decode('utf-8').strip().upper() for word in response if len(word.strip()) == 4)

# Add WEIR and DOWN to the set just in case
words.add('WEIR')
words.add('DOWN')

path = bfs('WEIR', 'DOWN', words)
print(f'Path 1: {path}')

# If no path, try the larger list again but filtered for commonality if possible
url2 = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dwyl/english-words/master/words_alpha.txt'
response2 = urllib.request.urlopen(url2)
words_all = set(word.decode('utf-8').strip().upper() for word in response2 if len(word.strip()) == 4)

path2 = bfs('WEIR', 'DOWN', words_all)
print(f'Path 2: {path2}')"}
